_comment.description: Documentation only — ignored. Present so config/ai.example.json can be copied to config/ai.json verbatim without tripping validation.

model.description: Default model id for skill runs and callAI(). May be a native Anthropic model id (e.g. "claude-sonnet-5") or an upstream gateway slug (e.g. "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6" via Vercel AI Gateway). Only used when the corresponding env var (ANTHROPIC_MODEL) is unset — env always wins. null/absent = no override, caller/SDK default applies.

smallFastModel.description: Default model id for small/fast (background/haiku-tier) work. Same id shape as `model`. Only used when ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL is unset — env always wins. null/absent = no override.
